outcome: Cesarean delivery for prolonged second stage
cohort: 2351 term singleton pregnancies with HC measurements up to 7 days before delivery
finding: Term HC above the 75th percentile was associated with increased rates of obstetric interventions because of a prolonged second stage and might be associated with neonatal asphyxia.
mod_finding: HC above the 75th percentile was independently associated with increased odds of OVD.
